name: Our Bloody Secret
source:
A year and a half ago, you arrived in this city looking for a fresh start.
...But the past doesn't always stay behind.

Nightmares feel more real than day.
Work is wearing you down.
You need to escape.
Even if just for a moment.

By a twist of fate, your routine is disrupted when you go to... a coffee shop.

A warm place.
A safe place.
At least, that's what it seems.
Perhaps you'll find solace there.

[Edited from [url=https://okami-liqueur.itch.io/our-bloody-secret]itch.io[/url]]
